content.title: Right heart catheterization and EMB (endomyocardial biopsy) recommendations

recommendations.recommendation: Recommended in patients with severe HF being evaluated for heart transplantation or MCS.
recommendations.notes: Used during evaluation for advanced therapies (transplantation or mechanical circulatory support).

recommendations.recommendation: Should be considered in patients where HF is thought to be due to constrictive pericarditis, restrictive cardiomyopathy, congenital heart disease, and high output states.
recommendations.notes: Suggested when these specific etiologies are suspected to clarify hemodynamics/diagnosis.

recommendations.recommendation: Should be considered in patients with probable pulmonary hypertension, assessed by echo, to confirm the diagnosis and assess its reversibility before correction of valve/structural heart disease.
recommendations.notes: Used to confirm pulmonary hypertension and evaluate reversibility prior to corrective procedures.

recommendations.recommendation: May be considered in selected patients with HFpEF to confirm the diagnosis.
recommendations.notes: Reserved for selected HF with preserved ejection fraction cases where invasive confirmation is needed.

recommendations.recommendation: Should be considered in patients with rapidly progressive HF despite standard therapy when there is a probability of a specific diagnosis that can be confirmed only in myocardial samples.
recommendations.notes: Indicated when myocardial tissue is required to confirm a specific, treatable diagnosis; references noted (97,98).
